name: Inpaint
author: hearth-team
description: Edit a region of an existing image — provide an image and a mask (white = edit, black = keep), and a prompt describing what to fill in. Routes through any installed provider that declares the inpaint capability (Replicate, fal, Stability, Ideogram).

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

settings.label: Preferred provider
settings.help: Pick a provider that declares the inpaint capability. fal-ai/flux-lora-inpaint works well.
